description.value:
This +3 greater resilient greater fortification breastplate absorbs impacts for later release. While wearing the armor, you gain resistance 5 to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and resistance 10 to force damage. Keep track of how much damage the armor prevents from enemy attacks, as the armor absorbs that damage. After 1 minute, the absorbed damage disperses harmlessly and resets to 0. Only damage caused by foes or hazards powers the armor, not damage you take from yourself, allies, or the environment.

Activate—Kinetic Pulse 1 (force, manipulate)

Requirements Your armor has absorbed at least @Damage[30[untyped]|options:area-damage] damage

Effect The absorbed energy explodes from your armor in a pulse of force. Creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] take @Damage[12d6[force]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:43|basic] save. On a failure, they're also pushed 10 feet away from you; on a critical failure, they're instead pushed 20 feet away from you and fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone]. The armor's absorbed damage resets to 0.
